title: LRU cache bounded by total weight
prompt:
The image proxy caches thumbnails in LRUCache (src/lru.ts), but it limits the number of entries, not bytes. Please add a weight-bounded variant in a new src/weightedLru.ts, exporting class WeightedLRU<K, V>:

new WeightedLRU({ maxWeight, weigh?, onEvict? })
- maxWeight must be a positive finite number, otherwise the constructor throws RangeError.
- weigh(value, key) gives an entry's weight (default: 1 for every entry). Weights may be 0 or fractional; if weigh returns a negative, NaN or infinite number, set throws RangeError and stores nothing.
- onEvict(key, value) is called for each entry removed to make room, least recently used first, after the entry has been removed. It is not called for delete, clear, replacing a key's value, or a rejected set.

Methods and getters:
- set(key, value): boolean. Stores the entry as most recently used, replacing any existing value for the key (its old weight no longer counts), then evicts least recently used entries until totalWeight <= maxWeight. The entry just set is never evicted. If the entry's weight alone is greater than maxWeight, set returns false and the cache is left exactly as it was (an existing entry for that key is kept). Otherwise it returns true.
- get(key): the value or undefined. A hit makes the entry most recently used. Every get counts as a hit or a miss.
- peek(key): the value or undefined, without touching recency or stats. has(key) likewise.
- delete(key): boolean, whether something was removed.
- clear(): removes every entry; stats are kept.
- size (entry count) and totalWeight getters.
- keys(): an array of the keys, from least to most recently used.
- stats(): { hits, misses, evictions }, where evictions counts entries removed to make room.

Leave LRUCache as it is.
acceptance: Default weight 1; LRU eviction until the weight fits with onEvict order and after removal; weigh(value, key); oversize set returns false and changes nothing; replacement frees old weight without onEvict; new entry never evicted; peek/has do not touch recency or stats; hit/miss/eviction stats; delete/clear semantics; zero and fractional weights; RangeError for bad maxWeight and weights.
difficulty_rationale: A stateful class with several interacting rules (recency, weight accounting on replace, rejection, callbacks, stats).
